items.title: Microsoft testing fix for Windows 11 Bluetooth audio quality drops
items.summary: Microsoft testing fix for Windows 11 Bluetooth audio quality drops By Sergiu Gatlan November 23, 2026 08:28 AM 0 Microsoft is working to fix a long-standing Windows issue that has been causing significant audio quality drops for Bluetooth headphone users. This is triggered when Windows automatically switches from the headphone (A2DP stereo) profile to the headset (hands-free, phone-call-like) profile when an app or game activates and uses the headset's microphone, because bandwidth is limited in two-way mode. After installing the preview builds released for the Beta and Experimental channels on Friday, Windows 11 Insiders with newer Bluetooth headsets can keep playing high-quality audio even after the OS switches between profiles. "Bluetooth LE Audio devices can now play at full-range stereo fidelity while also using the device's microphone, ensuring you continue to hear great audio quality when in game chat, in a voice call, using voice typing, or using voice chat in Copilot Chat," said Windows Insider communications lead Stephen Lines. "When using an LE Audio device with a PC that supports Super Wideband Stereo, choose the new 2 channels, 16 bit, 48000Hz option from Settings > System > Sound > Output > {Bluetooth device} > Output settings > Format when microphone is active." items.title: Hackers Exploited GL.iNet Cloud Flaw to Install Malware on Routers and KVM Devices
items.summary: Hackers exploited a vulnerability in GL.iNet's GoodCloud remote management service to install malware on some customer routers and KVM devices, the maker of travel routers and remote-access KVM hardware said in a security notice updated today. The company identified and fixed the flaw on Friday and blocked the access the attacker used, so devices can no longer be infected through this route.
